Bhubaneswar is Odisha’s capital and a fast-growing centre for IT, education, and industry — with the Mancheswar and Chandaka industrial estates and the Cuttack-Paradip corridor nearby. These sites need a durable porta cabin in Bhubaneswar — site offices, security cabins, and worker rooms built for a coastal, high-rainfall climate. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Bhubaneswar in 4 to 5 days. For Odisha’s coastal humidity and monsoon we build with corrosion protection and secure anchoring. For a porta cabin in Bhubaneswar, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Why Bhubaneswar Buyers Choose SAMAN

The porta cabin results a Bhubaneswar buyer finds online are mostly IndiaMART and TradeIndia directories — supplier cards that say nothing about frame grade, corrosion protection, or how the cabin is anchored. For coastal Odisha, with its humidity, monsoon, and exposure to strong seasonal winds, those are exactly the details that decide whether a cabin lasts.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. We build our porta cabins in-house, so when you call us you reach the team that builds the cabin. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated — corrosion-protected for coastal air
  • 50 mm PUF or cement-board panels with factory-sealed joints
  • Colour-coated GI roof with drainage slope and secure fixings
  • Anchor-bolt mounting to an RCC plinth for stability in strong winds
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Bhubaneswar: 4–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer’s cost.

Bhubaneswar’s Industries and Construction Demand

Bhubaneswar and the wider Khordha-Cuttack region generate several distinct sources of porta cabin demand:

Mancheswar Industrial Estate (PIN 751010): Bhubaneswar’s main industrial estate — engineering, fabrication, packaging, and light manufacturing. Security cabins at plot entries and portable supervisor offices are the common requirements.

Chandaka Industrial Estate (PIN 751024): An IT and electronics-focused industrial area near the Infocity IT hub. Campus and commercial construction here uses porta cabins as contractor offices and visitor-entry cabins through the build phase.

Khordha-Cuttack industrial spillover and Paradip corridor: The Bhubaneswar-Cuttack-Paradip axis is one of eastern India’s growing industrial and port-logistics corridors. Infrastructure and plant construction along it generates multi-room contractor offices and labour accommodation demand.

Construction and institutional projects: Bhubaneswar’s rapid growth — IT parks, universities and institutions, residential development, and Smart City works — drives steady demand for contractor site offices and site-management cabins.

We dispatch from Greater Noida via the NH-19 / NH-16 corridor through eastern India — bringing cabins to Bhubaneswar in 4–5 days. We supply porta cabins across eastern India, from our porta cabin in Kolkata service to our porta cabin in Patna service, all dispatched factory-direct on the same eastern corridor.

Porta Cabin Specifications — Built for Coastal Odisha

Bhubaneswar’s coastal climate brings high humidity, heavy monsoon, and exposure to strong seasonal winds. Every cabin is specified accordingly.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. For coastal-proximity sites we add an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before powder coat to resist salt-laden humidity.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard. Cement-board panels recommended for sites with sustained high humidity or coastal exposure.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with a controlled drainage slope, internal false ceiling, and secure roof fixings. Factory-sealed joints keep the cabin watertight through Odisha’s monsoon.

Anchoring: We anchor-bolt the frame to an RCC plinth. Proper anchoring matters in coastal Odisha, where seasonal winds can be strong — a well-anchored cabin on a sound plinth is far more stable than an un-anchored unit. We provide the anchor-bolt pattern and load data so your site team can prepare the plinth correctly. (We do not claim cyclone-proofing; we provide secure anchoring and corrosion protection appropriate to the coastal environment.)

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate; elevated flooring on MS joists available for low-lying or waterlogged sites.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Bhubaneswar

  • Security cabins at Mancheswar and Chandaka industrial plot entries
  • Contractor and visitor-entry cabins at Infocity IT campus construction
  • Multi-room contractor offices at Cuttack-Paradip corridor projects
  • Labour accommodation blocks at large infrastructure and plant construction
  • Site-management offices at Smart City, university, and housing projects
  • Portable stores for tools and materials at project yards

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Epoxy primer + cement-board upgrade for coastal/high-humidity sites
  • Secure anchor-bolt mounting with load data for wind-exposed sites
  • RAL colour choice
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for summer heat and humidity
  • Elevated MS-joist flooring for low-lying sites
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Bhubaneswar — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF vs cement-board (cement board preferred coastal/humid).
  3. Coastal spec — epoxy primer coat and secure anchoring for exposed sites.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Bhubaneswar for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Bhubaneswar

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the NH-19 / NH-16 corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 4–5 days (Bhubaneswar is farther east than our other North-dispatch cities, so allow the upper end of the range). We arrange dispatch from our North India factory and onward to Bhubaneswar on a factory-direct basis. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins and exact freight for Cuttack/Paradip-side sites. We have no Bhubaneswar warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Site Readiness Before Your Cabin Arrives

A smooth installation in Bhubaneswar depends on a few things being ready before the flatbed reaches your gate:

  • A level RCC plinth poured to our anchor-bolt pattern — for low-lying or waterlogged coastal plots, plan an elevated plinth so the cabin floor sits clear of standing monsoon water.
  • Truck and crane access: confirm the approach road and gate can take a flatbed and, for multi-room blocks, a hydra or crane for placement.
  • A temporary power point to connect the cabin’s MCB board, so we can hand over a working unit the same day.
  • Clear placement marking for the door orientation, so the cabin is set in its final position in one lift.

Share photographs of your site with your enquiry and we will flag anything that needs attention before dispatch.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Bhubaneswar

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Mancheswar, Chandaka, and Cuttack?

Yes. We deliver across Bhubaneswar — Mancheswar Industrial Estate, Chandaka Industrial Estate, Infocity — and to Cuttack and Khordha-region construction sites. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 4–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard; confirm exact freight for Cuttack/Paradip-side sites at order stage.

How does a SAMAN porta cabin handle coastal Odisha’s humidity and winds?

We add an epoxy primer coat before powder coat for coastal-proximity sites and recommend cement-board panels for sustained humidity. The frame is anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth for stability in strong seasonal winds, and we provide the anchor-bolt pattern and load data so your plinth is prepared correctly. We do not claim cyclone-proofing — we provide proper corrosion protection and secure anchoring suited to the coastal environment.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Bhubaneswar?

Price depends on size, panel type, coastal corrosion spec, and fit-out level. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for an IT campus or government project in Bhubaneswar?

Yes. We supply IT-campus contractors, infrastructure project managers, and government contractors. Our NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition, ISO certificates, GST registration, and incorporation documents are available for vendor empanelment. Share your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

How long does delivery from the factory to Bhubaneswar take?

4–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-19 / NH-16 corridor, after production is complete. Bhubaneswar is farther east than most of our North-dispatch cities, so allow the upper end of the range. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry.
